Rationale: bootstrap-request.json originally named linh-explorer.myshopify.com (TIB_STORE_URL_1), but a documented precedent run (runs/context/2026-09-12/CTX-20260912-03/raw/storefront/storefront-evidence-store1-v1.json) found that store's add-to-cart flow for this same campaign (2595) never completes (CONFLICT-001 in that run: generic validation error, zero network request to cart) — placing a real order there was not possible with available evidence. linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com successfully completed the full storefront checkout flow twice in this run. This is an accepted, evidence-based deviation from the original bootstrap-request.json scope, not an error. Recorded in knowledge/products/teeinblue/objects/order/kb.json under payload.orchestrator_publish_notes and payload.kb_context.authoritative_store — the underlying producer content (kb_candidates, unknowns, coverage_gaps) was left unmodified per contract §2.7 (agents don't silently edit upstream artifacts); this decision is an additive orchestrator-level annotation only. Future work targeting linh-explorer.myshopify.com specifically must treat this KB's storefront findings as not-yet-verified there and should first re-investigate that store's add-to-cart issue.
